name: Mountain Lake Whale
appearance: A small, pale, land-locked baleen whale of the high glacial lakes, its bone plates coated in mineral-slick calcium that looks like shelf ice; its blow freezes the moment it leaves the water into floating crystal canopies.
journal_prompt: When the moon sits flat on Chandra-Taal, the mirror-glider rises, humming at a pitch that makes the lake-bottom stones ring.
notes: Descended from Tethys Leviathan pods trapped in rising valleys when the plates collided and pushed up Jambhudweep's highland spine; they grew a vascular antifreeze and woolly blubber. Himachali villagers call them the sacred mounts of the lake-spirits, carrying the monasteries' prayers in their lungs. Lore only, not placed in the game.
